title: building //tools/... crashes

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
I synced with master after a long time, then ran ./compile.sh test. Then I copied output/bazel to ~/bin and ran ~/bin/bazel test -k -- //... -//src/java_tools/singlejar:zipTests

I got a huge number of errors like:

ERROR: /Users/janakr/bazel/out/com/google/devtools/build/lib/BUILD:423:1: Target '//out/com/google/devtools/build/lib:util' contains an error and its package is in error and referenced by '//out/com/google/devtools/build/lib:bazel-core'.

(I think the original errors were about packages not existing.) Then there was a crash:

java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Multiple entries with same key: tools/build_rules/go/toolchain=/Users/janakr/bazel and tools/build_rules/go/toolchain=/Users/janakr/bazel
